scope: Development-only pooled PPO. No held-out execution, tuning or promotion.

curriculum.question: Can one pooled local-history policy learn useful behavior across the known native assembly family?
curriculum.scope: Development-only anchored planar two-link fixture, one motor, one IMU and one light. This pilot tests pooled sensor-history PPO, not topology generalization or a first child-built creature.

development_gate.interpretation: Source competence diagnostic only: every frozen policy opportunity must safely complete and beat its paired quiet native return by more than 3.2. Pilot completion alone is not a research pass and never authorizes reserved-case exposure.

sampling.rule: Independent random.Random(source_seed+500000); shuffle all source indices once per cycle; draw each once; never rewind when policy/action RNG resets.

ppo.network: Separate two-layer 64x64 tanh actor/value networks; categorical 3-action output
ppo.normalization: Advantage normalization only; fixed sensor scaling; no VecNormalize.
ppo.transfer: Pilot development evaluation uses final actor+critic weights frozen; no development optimizer updates.

policy_input.initialization: 11 zero absent frames plus current local frame; invalid sensor values zero under validity masks.
policy_input.critic: Same local stack as actor; no privileged critic inputs.

curriculum.native_reward: Unmodified mounted light plus IMU rewards, integrated by the native world every .002s and summed over five .02s controls per decision; no shaping or reward normalization.
curriculum.reset: New deterministic hanging native world with q=v=0, fresh motor state and sensor queues; curriculum case draws use their own recorded seed and schedule.
curriculum.safety: The existing native governor runs every .02s. Any native veto or motor feedback flag ends a development opportunity; preserve the raw prefix and do not reset-rescue it. Source episodes may reset after safety termination and every such stop is counted.
curriculum.checkpoint_rule: Final pilot checkpoint only, sealed before all development evaluations; no outcome-based checkpoint, seed, hyperparameter or case selection.
curriculum.untrained_baseline: Matched architecture and source initialization seed 404, frozen without learning; reset the same per-case action RNG after construction as for the trained frozen branch. Report trained-minus-untrained native returns separately; this comparison adds no pass threshold.
curriculum.reserve_rule: The twelve reserved cases are manifest data only in this pilot: no native construction, probes, policy rollout, adaptation or reward inspection. A later prospectively declared study is required before their exposure.
